title: Lindy alternatives, with checked prices | 50agents
description: Lindy alternatives: Gumloop for team AI agents, Relevance AI for sales, Zapier Agents, n8n to self-host, and 50agents for AI agents plus apps. Prices checked.
answer: If your team builds and shares AI agents, Gumloop is made for that; if the assistant is mainly for sales, Relevance AI ships ready-made teams of sales AI agents.
If the data must stay on your own servers, n8n's AI Agent node runs self-hosted; if you want AI agents plus the apps and automations around them, 50agents builds all four from plain words.
ask: Set up an AI agent that reads new support emails, drafts a reply from what you know about my business, and asks me before sending
lede: Lindy is an AI assistant you talk to, billed for every active user, and its credit-using actions pause when the pool runs low.

entries.suits: People who want what Lindy does for their inbox, plus the team tools around it: a leads app, a requests desk, an automation that logs every payment.
entries.limit: It does not live in iMessage or Slack DMs the way Lindy does, and it cannot learn a task by watching you once.

entries.suits: Teams that build AI agents once and share them, with IT deciding which tools and models each person may use.
entries.price: No free plan. Pro: $37 a month (20,000 credits)
entries.limit: No free plan: a 14-day Pro trial with a card, and credits do not roll over.

entries.suits: Sales and revenue teams who want teams of AI agents wired into Salesforce, HubSpot and Gong, with reps approving drafts from Slack or Teams.
entries.price: No free plan. Pro: $19 a month billed yearly (2,500 actions)
entries.limit: The free plan is retired, and extra actions cost $80 per 1,000 above the plan.

entries.suits: Teams already running Zaps who want an AI agent that can use them. Zapier Agents sit next to your Zaps in the same account.
entries.price: Free: 100 tasks a month. Professional: $19.99 a month billed yearly (750 tasks)
entries.limit: Zapier Agents are billed in activities, on top of Zap tasks, so you track two meters.

entries.suits: Teams with a developer who want an AI agent whose data stays on their own servers. The AI Agent node is on every plan.
entries.price: No free cloud plan. Starter: €20 a month billed yearly (2.5K executions)
entries.limit: It is a workflow builder, not an assistant you chat with all day: someone has to build the AI agent node by node.

us: You want AI agents and the apps and automations around them in one workspace.
Several people will use it, and you would rather not add a seat for each one.
You want anything sent to people outside to wait for your yes.
them: You want an assistant in iMessage, Slack and email, not another app to open. That is where Lindy is strongest.
You teach it by showing it once. Lindy's Watch and Learn is something the tools here do not match.
It is just you, so per-user billing costs you nothing extra.

move.title: Write down what each Lindy does
move.body: We found no export for Lindy AI agents on Lindy's own pages, so open each one and copy its instructions, its apps, when it runs and what it asks before acting.

move.title: Turn each into one sentence
move.body: For example "draft a reply to each new support email and ask me before sending". That sentence is what you give Captain or any other builder.

move.title: Reconnect the apps
move.body: Gmail, Calendar and Slack connections do not move. Connect them in the new tool; 50agents asks for each one in the chat when it needs it.

move.title: Pause Lindy before the cycle renews
move.body: Run the new AI agent for a few days while Lindy is paused, then cancel before the next billing cycle; monthly Lindy credits do not roll over.

faqs.q: What is cheaper than Lindy for a team?
faqs.a: Lindy bills every active user from $29.99 a month, so the gap grows with each person. Compare the tools in the table on what a whole team pays, not one seat; 50agents is free to start for the whole workspace.

faqs.q: Is there a free Lindy alternative?
faqs.a: Lindy itself gives $50 in credits for 7 days. Zapier and 50agents have ongoing free starts; Gumloop and Relevance AI have no free plan.

faqs.q: Which Lindy alternative works with the most apps?
faqs.a: Zapier, with 10,541+. Lindy lists 2,733 apps plus MCP servers, and 50agents works with 2,300+ through viaSocket.
